What it does

Semrush is the research layer behind local search: what people search for in your area, who currently ranks, and what is technically broken on your site. It is powerful but has a steep learning curve. For a trade business it earns its keep mainly through local keyword tracking and competitor research, not the full feature set.

Where the AI actually is

AI assists with keyword research, content ideas and site audits.

Pros

  • Deep keyword and competitor data
  • Tracks local rankings
  • Site audit finds technical problems

Cons

  • Steep learning curve
  • Overkill for basic needs

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Roofers, Landscapers in mind. Businesses serious about ranking for local searches.

Alternatives
